quests.name: The Spirits of Stonetalon
quests.text: Speak with Seereth Stonebreak in the Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Kaya's Alive
quests.text: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

quests.name: Protect Kaya
quests.text: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

quests.name: Avenge My Village
quests.text: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

quests.name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
quests.text: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

quests.name: The Elder Crone
quests.text: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Boulderslide Ravine
quests.text: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

quests.name: Goblin Invaders
quests.text: Kill 15 Venture Co. Loggers, then return to Seereth Stonebreak on the border of Stonetalon and the Barrens.

quests.name: Blood Feeders
quests.text: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

quests.name: Report to Kadrak
quests.text: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

quests.name: Earthen Arise
quests.text: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

quests.name: Ken'zigla's Draught
quests.text: Bring Ken'zigla's Draught to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Arachnophobia
quests.text: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth's Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

quests.name: Super Reaper 6000
quests.text: Get the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints for Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Further Instructions
quests.text: Deliver the Sealed Envelope to Sputtervalve in the Barrens.

quests.name: A Gnome's Respite
quests.text: Kill 10 Venture Co. Loggers, and 10 Venture Co. Deforesters and return to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.

quests.name: An Old Colleague
quests.text: Speak to Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge.

quests.name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
quests.text: Bring 4 Minor Mana Potions and 2 Elixirs of Minor Fortitude to Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge.

quests.name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
quests.text: Bring the Nitromirglyceronium back to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.

quests.name: A Scroll from Mauren
quests.text: Find Collin Mauren in Stormwind.

quests.name: Devils in Westfall
quests.text: Bring Dust Devil Debris to Collin Mauren in Stormwind.

quests.name: Special Delivery for Gaxim
quests.text: Bring the Scroll of Messaging to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.

quests.name: Covert Ops - Alpha
quests.text: Retrieve the Venture Co.'s Engineering Plans from the lumber mill in Windshear Crag.

quests.name: Covert Ops - Beta
quests.text: Retrieve the Venture Co. Letters from Windshear Mine at the east end of Windshear Crag.

quests.name: Update for Sentinel Thenysil
quests.text: Return to Sentinel Thenysil in Ashenvale.

quests.name: Gerenzo's Orders
quests.text: Get the mysterious ore from Piznik after he finishes mining it.

quests.name: Kaela's Update
quests.text: Bring the Venture Co. Letters to Kaela Shadowspear.

quests.name: Gerenzo's Orders
quests.text: Deliver the Unidentified Ore to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Goblin Lockpicks
quests.text: Find The Horn of Xelthos inside of Shadowfang Keep. Then, return it to C's dead drop near Pyrewood Village.

quests.name: Shredding Machines
quests.text: Kill the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, then return to Seereth Stonebreak at the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens.

quests.name: Cycle of Rebirth
quests.text: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

quests.name: Scramble
quests.text: Find what awaits you.

quests.name: Stonetalon Supply Run
quests.text: Collect 6 Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.

quests.name: New Life
quests.text: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

quests.name: Elemental War
quests.text: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

quests.name: Cenarius' Legacy
quests.text: Kill 4 Sons of Cenarius, 4 Daughters of Cenarius and 4 Cenarion Botanists for Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.

quests.name: Retrieval for Mauren
quests.text: Bring 8 Crystalized Scales to Collin Mauren in Stormwind.

quests.name: Harpies Threaten
quests.text: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

quests.name: Bloodfury Bloodline
quests.text: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

quests.name: Bloodfury Trinkets
quests.text: Bring 15 Glittering Sunstones to Mor'rogal.

quests.name: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic
quests.text: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of Stonetalon Sap, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a Fey Dragon Scale.

quests.name: Enraged Spirits
quests.text: Bring 8 Smoldering Embers from any of the fire elementals in the Charred Vale to Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon.

quests.name: Pigments for Paints
quests.text: Tah Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff wants 30 Mirkweed Pods from Mirkfallon Lake.

quests.name: Further Instructions
quests.text: Bring the new orders to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle
quests.text: Bring Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle's Mechanical Arm to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.name: Reclaiming the Charred Vale
quests.text: Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
notes: On Forever you need only 6 of each harpy type, not 7.

quests.name: Reclaiming the Charred Vale
quests.text: Travel to Falfindel Waywarder on the border of Thousand Needles and Feralas.

quests.name: Reception from Tyrande
quests.text: Find Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.

quests.name: Wounded Ancients
quests.text: Bring a piece of Corroded Shrapnel to Kaela Shadowspear in Stonetalon.

quests.name: Calling in the Reserves
quests.text: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.

quests.name: Ordanus
quests.text: Bring Ordanus' head to Braelyn Firehand near Sun Rock Retreat.

quests.name: The Den
quests.text: Travel to the Den on Stonetalon Peak. Using the Gatekeeper's Key, obtain the druids' hidden items. Use these items to open the Talon Den Hoard.

quests.name: Wet Job
quests.text: Dusting off a messenger bag emerging from the soil, you find a parchment nestled among the supplies.

quests.name: Your First Riding Kodo
quests.text: Inspect the riding kodos to choose your first mount.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Lesser Agility
quests.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Rough Bronze Leggings
quests.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

quests.name: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Quiver
quests.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
